textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Electricity: Circuits and their Components · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Copper, iron and aluminium allow electric current to pass readily. The plastic coatings used on suitable wires are poor conductors. They are examples of insulators.

beats.en: Copper, iron and aluminium allow electric current to pass readily. The plastic coatings used on suitable wires are poor conductors. They are examples of insulators. Wires have a metal core and a plastic cover for safety.
beats.speakEn: Copper, iron and aluminium allow electric current to pass readily. The plastic coatings used on suitable wires are poor conductors. They are examples of insulators. Wires have a metal core and a plastic cover for safety.

beats.en: In a series circuit the bulbs are joined one after another. If one bulb fuses, all go off. In a parallel circuit each bulb has its own path. If one fuses, the others stay on. House wiring is parallel.
beats.speakEn: In a series circuit the bulbs are joined one after another. If one bulb fuses, all go off. In a parallel circuit each bulb has its own path. If one fuses, the others stay on. House wiring is parallel.
